title: Choose a plan
description: Start your free trial. You're only charged for answered calls.

title: Set up your call voice
description: Pick a ready-made Urdu or English voice, or upload a recording with your store name.

title: Choose which orders get a call
description: For example: only COD orders, only web orders, or skip certain cities.

title: Turn on order protection
description: Catch duplicate orders, invalid phone numbers, and incomplete addresses before you call.

title: Start calling
description: Switch calling on. New orders will get a confirmation call within minutes.
